力残差、振动模式、计算条件和容差

questions.title: 保留拓扑的构象修复

questions.title: 构象集合中的最相近一对
missing: 同分子构象集合、原子对应、重原子选择规则
questions.validation: RMSD with fixed alignment/permutation policy.

questions.title: 构象多样性与局部扭转
missing: 构象集合、四原子二面角定义、区间端点约定
questions.validation: Periodic dihedral computation and bins.

questions.title: 主要构象是否也最紧凑
missing: 同分子结构、能量、简并度、温度

questions.validation: Population plus coordinate compactness; no causal generalization or exact free-energy claim.

questions.title: 覆盖多样性的构象生成
missing: 真实分子、原子与立体约束、生成数目
参考集合、能量阈值和去重约定

questions.validation: Validity, uniqueness, coverage and energy evaluated separately.

questions.title: 形变最显著的局部区域
missing: 配对平衡/非平衡结构、键列表、原子对应
questions.validation: Pairwise bond-length differences under a verified common unit.

questions.title: 力与原子位移的方向
missing: 配对几何、目标原子的力、力与坐标单位
计算级别、零值判定阈值
questions.validation: Sign of force-displacement dot product; local inference only.

questions.title: 几何相似但性质不同
missing: 同分子匹配结构、偶极矩及统一计算条件
结构差异度量与近零分母规则
questions.validation: Joint geometry/property calculation; no universal structure-property law.

questions.title: 受限非平衡结构生成
missing: 参考结构、归一化模式、幅度、坐标单位
Design评分器尚未实现
questions.validation: Normal-mode displacement and constraints; distinguish manipulation from optimized design.

questions.title: 几何重建与拓扑重建
missing: 参考/重建XYZ、拓扑、原子对应
组成匹配前提和两类评分阈值
questions.validation: RMSD plus graph comparison; no assumed equivalence.

questions.title: 性质相似是否唯一确定结构
missing: 实际结构集合及性质向量
目标、单位、容差、结构等价定义
questions.validation: Target acceptance plus structural distinctness; finite-set conclusion only.

questions.title: 双性质约束结构设计
missing: 真实目标、单位、容差与组成范围
统一量化计算方法和评分预算

questions.title: 保持性质的结构多样性

questions.question: For the supplied BCD host conformer, what is the straight-line distance between atoms 57 and 68? Report the distance in angstrom to three decimal places.

This is a geometric measurement, not a prediction of binding affinity or solvent-accessible cavity size.

questions.title: BCD · 桥连氧处的 C–O–C 键角
missing: 待独立领域审核与难度测试
仅验证一个局部结构模板，不代表批量质量提升
questions.validation: PDB 原子名与 CONECT 45 4 37 核对；acos 计算和 atan2 公式复核一致。v0.4 同会话筛查通过，非专家认证。
questions.question: In the supplied beta-cyclodextrin host conformer, oxygen O3 bridges carbon C4 and carbon C37, forming a C4-O3-C37 linkage. What is the C-O-C bond angle at this bridging oxygen? Report the angle in degrees to two decimal places.
questions.inputObject: BCD 主体分子完整构象
questions.sizeDefinition: 输入：全部重原子的最大中心距；推理：题目指定原子子集的最大中心距。不是溶液尺寸或空腔直径。
questions.rubric: Compute the vector angle at the middle atom. Absolute tolerance 0.1 degree. Equivalent rounding within tolerance is accepted. No thermodynamic conclusion is requested.
questions.attribution: SAMPL9 challenge contributors · CC BY 4.0；PDB 转换为 XYZ，保留原子顺序与坐标。
questions.inputInstructions: Use BCD.xyz, the complete supplied 147-atom structure with coordinates in angstrom. PDB atom identities map to XYZ atom rows as follows: C4 (carbon) = row 4; O3 (oxygen, angle vertex) = row 45; C37 (carbon) = row 37. Atom rows are counted from 1 after the two XYZ header lines (physical file lines 6, 47 and 39 respectively). The supplied PDB connectivity is CONECT 45 4 37: O3 is bonded to the two listed carbons. Measure the C4-O3-C37 angle in this single conformer; do not optimize the geometry or infer binding affinity. The attachment asset is S0005; its downloaded filename may differ from BCD.xyz.
questions.policyReview: v0.4 同会话初筛通过；尚无专家审核与难度验证。
